name: freshness-fast-path
body: Feature scan-freshness (win A). When the scan's recorded git/content state matches the current tree exactly, `apg scan` must reuse the existing DB and skip the language frontends entirely, so a no-op re-scan is effectively instant. The fast-path is pure APG-level and reuses the existing scan_meta / Scan node state. This capability decomposes into the no-op fast-path and the content-identity rule it depends on.
